summary: Tested Admin Analytics revenue separation feature and Teacher Dashboard 'Cours' tab removal. Fixed a critical bug in /admin/analytics endpoint where amount values stored as strings caused TypeError. All 10 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified - revenue chart shows two lines (Entrées/Sorties), net revenue card shows +X€/-Y€ format, and 'Cours' tab is correctly removed from teacher dashboard.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed TypeError in /admin/analytics endpoint: Added safe_amount() helper to convert string amounts to float (line 4298-4311)
/app/backend/tests/test_analytics_revenue.py - Created comprehensive test suite for revenue separation feature
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Analytics revenue separation feature fully tested and working. The /admin/analytics endpoint now returns incoming_eur, outgoing_eur, net_eur (and FCFA equivalents) in summary and revenue_by_month. Frontend AdminAnalytics.js displays two-line chart (green for Entrées, red for Sorties) and net revenue card with +X€/-Y€ format. Teacher dashboard 'Cours' tab (value='courses') has been removed - all other tabs working correctly.

admin_analytics_revenue_separation.revenue_by_month_structure: Each month has incoming_eur, incoming_fcfa, outgoing_eur, outgoing_fcfa
admin_analytics_revenue_separation.frontend_chart: Two-line chart with Entrées (green) and Sorties (red)
admin_analytics_revenue_separation.frontend_card: Revenus nets card shows net value with +X€/-Y€ format

bug_fixed.issue: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str' - The amount field in student_receipts and teacher_payments collections was stored as string, causing sum() to fail
bug_fixed.fix: Added safe_amount() helper function to convert string amounts to float before summing
bug_fixed.impact: /admin/analytics endpoint now works correctly and returns revenue data
